game.title: LEGO The Lord of the Rings
game.blurb: Family action-adventure from Traveller's Tales (RAWG also lists Warner Bros. Interactive), published by Warner Bros. Interactive, released 2012-10-30. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters follow the 18 story levels named in the Steam achievements, plus chapters drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Prologue to Amon Hen
chapters.summary: Story levels 1 to 6: Prologue, The Black Rider, Weathertop, The Pass of Caradhras, The Mines of Moria and Amon Hen, with their level feats.

chapters.title: Taming Gollum to Osgiliath
chapters.summary: Story levels 7 to 12: Taming Gollum, The Dead Marshes, Track Hobbits, Warg Attack, Helm's Deep and Osgiliath. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Secret Stairs to Mount Doom
chapters.summary: Story levels 13 to 18: The Secret Stairs, Cirith Ungol, The Paths of the Dead, The Battle of Pelennor Fields, The Black Gate and Mount Doom. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Middle-earth, Collectibles and 100%
chapters.summary: The open Middle-earth map: Mithril Bricks and items, Red Bricks, Map Stones, Fetch Quests, travelling to Trollshaws, Isengard and Mordor, True Adventurer, the Bonus Level, every character, studs and 100%.

chapters.title: Characters, Co-op and Fun Feats
chapters.summary: Co-op play, throwing Gimli, fishing, cooking puzzles, the Ent Draught, treasure outfits, the Mushroom Crown and other character tricks.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 2597). The Steam store list has one matching app, 214510 ("LEGO® The Lord of the Rings™"); its schema is named "ValveTestApp214510" (a placeholder name). StrategyWiki has "LEGO The Lord of the Rings" at completion stage 0 (marked as a perfect stub article). Only Prologue (about 5,000 characters), The Black Rider (about 4,700), Walkthrough (about 250) and Table of Contents (about 1,900) are written; Gameplay, Controls, Abilities, Characters, Extras, Cheat Codes, Mithril Items, Mithril Bricks, Achievements and trophies and the other 16 level pages are linked but not written, so it was not used. Its contents list 18 levels in the same order as the Steam achievements, but spells two of them "Wheatertop" and "The Battle of Pellenor Fields" and has "Minas Morgul" where the Steam achievement for level 14 says "Cirith Ungol"; the chapters use the Steam spellings. lego.fandom.com answers the API under "LEGO The Lord of the Rings" with about 172 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 48 Steam achievements is hidden. COMPLETE_STORYEVENT1 to 18 name the levels in order; the split into three chapters of six is our own choice. Level-specific feats (Moria in under 15 minutes, the top of Amon Hen without Boromir catching you, Legolas in Helm's Deep, Isildur in the Prologue) sit in their level chapters. Travelling to Trollshaws, Isengard and Mordor was put with the Middle-earth map as a guess; "Defeat Gollum as Gollum", "Defeat an Oliphaunt as Legolas" and "Form The Fellowship of the Ring" do not name a level and sit in the feats chapter.
